procedural_matters: FRA 2998 was represented by Jouan Barnabe.
Race committee was represented by Fabian Bach.
The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: During race F1 of gold fleet, the conditions during the time of the incident were 20 knots of wind with light chop.
On the last leg to finish right after rounding mark 2p, the crew of FRA 2998 fell out of the boat.
The helm of FRA 2998 continued sailing and crossed the finishing line without crew on board or in contact with the boat.
conclusions: Since the crew of FRA 2998 left the boat by accident and was not back in contact with the boat before resuming sailing, he broke RRS 48.2.
decision: FRA 2998 is DSQ in race F1.
